primary_findings.fact: The child trade_stream boolean is the venue router aggregate any(status.trade_stream), not Kalshi socket connectivity or a Kalshi-only freshness certificate.

The Kalshi adapter trade_stream is bool(maker_windows), where maker windows are the union of eligible REST and WS windows. Healthy Bitcoin or book updates alone do not establish eligible recent trade tape.

Every aggregate status callback queues a gap wire record, even unchanged false state; V1 permanently stores a preforecast gap on an active pending window for false booleans or explicit slug. This is broader than the falling-edge cancellation logic.

A Kalshi adapter true-to-false transition creates explicit gaps for the union of current and previous known venue windows. Those Kalshi slugs reach the child even if another venue keeps aggregate trade_stream true.

status_path.semantics: _report merges changes into sticky adapter status but defaults gap_windows to []; _publish recomputes maker availability. _ws_report strips gap_windows from sticky WS status, invalidates REST eligibility for reported tickers, then republishes explicit gaps.

Router retains per-venue status, adds all current/previous venue windows on adapter true-to-false trade_stream, propagates explicit string gap slugs intersected with those windows, derives coinbase solely from the polymarket_us LiveFeeds status, derives trade_stream via any venue. maker_windows filters each adapter by its own stream status.

On false availability clear last-fresh evidence; remove explicit-gap coverage. On falling stream/BTC or explicit gaps invalidate live snapshot. Falling global stream/BTC cancels all practice orders, else explicit slugs cancel by window. Full status is passed to live callback; arena receives only slugs and two coerced booleans on every callback.

g record has exactly tag, slug tuple, trade_stream bool, coinbase bool. No producer timestamp, reason, venue, eligibility ages, event id, or connection identity. Frame now sampled at start of _flush is sent with batch sequence and drop count; event can already have waited in parent FIFO before that sample. It is a frame clock, not status occurrence or exact socket send completion.

receive samples child clock then enqueues g event; drain applies FIFO later at child now. Multiple received batches retain separate frame contexts. Snapshot windows are discovered before drain/advance. Thus a gap produced/received before window start but applied after start may count as an active V1 gap; the unchanged wire cannot recover its producer occurrence.

gap always updates global feed_ok=trade_stream and coinbase; for start<=apply_now<end, false feed_ok or selected slug writes pregap if forecast None, else post_gaps. Recovery resets feed_ok but never clears stored pregap. degrade differs: start<=now only, no end bound. At horizon300-305s the learner rejects stored pregap OR degraded map OR current feed_ok false. Child supplies an empty degraded map; sticky simulator degradation is not replayed as untimed learner history.

producer_false_or_explicit_gap_routes.what_can_happen: WS book and connection can remain fresh while last accepted non-block trade is older than3s, so ws_maker_windows becomes empty. Its disappearance explicitly gaps the ticker even if ws_books stays fresh. REST maker eligibility also expires after3s since last qualifying actual print; successful empty/no-fresh-print polls do not refresh it. This route is plausible source semantics, not an attribution of the target slot.

WS fresh_books requires connected and both local book receipt and exchange time in[0,3]s. Losing fresh book membership generates explicit gaps from old-fresh. A healthy local connection alone is insufficient; initial untimestamped snapshot is not a proven fresh book.

MarketDataGap can arise for timestamp, sequence, malformed/ambiguous frame, reversed time, invalid quantity/price/depth or changed market set. Session finally marks disconnected and invalidates all tickers before awaited close; reconnect status gets flattened into booleans/slugs for the child.
Switching book.source between transports discards REST eligibility and explicitly gaps the ticker before delivering the new book, preserving maker queue uncertainty even if prices match.

Changing discovered window set clears REST eligibility and reports trade_stream false and all old windows as gaps, then replaces windows. Metadata errors report metadata_unavailable plus false and old slugs before clearing windows. This can invalidate active learning despite healthy BTC or available books.
A failed/invalid REST book fetch removes REST eligibility and publishes book_unavailable plus explicit ticker gap.
A failed or incomplete tape poll removes REST eligibility and publishes trade_tape_gap plus explicit ticker; successful no-new-print is a different upstream case but wire has no reason.
Kalshi run finally reports stopped,false,empty maker list,all windows gaps.

Coinbase bool is true while any one Coinbase feed socket is up; both down/connecting makes child bool false. A connected status does not prove fresh BTC tick; actual BTC age is separately checked by learner at due. Individual connection failures, duplicates, no recent accepted tick and future-stamped rejections are not encoded in g.

unchanged_wire_cannot_distinguish: Quiet accepted-trade expiry versus real trade-feed loss behind trade_stream=false or explicit slug.
A failed REST tape poll versus successful quiet poll versus WS maker-age expiry from the same child flags.
Book staleness, missing engine timestamp, protocol/sequence rejection, transport change, metadata transition, REST failure or shutdown behind the same explicit slug.
Whether aggregate trade_stream false originated in Kalshi, another venue, or simultaneous adapter states; true also does not certify Kalshi availability.
Which Coinbase connection failed; connected socket versus fresh accepted tick; genuine upstream gap versus source-local callback processing delay.
Producer on_status occurrence, parent FIFO time, unique event-to-frame join, or upstream root cause. Batch timestamp is not occurrence and excludes earlier parent FIFO residence.
